items.title: Ran Blake interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 16, 2021

ctx.x: I see. I’m going to take you back and challenge your memory I think but the work you did in the 60s with Jeanne Lee and I listened to the “Newest Sounds Around You Never Heard.”
Oh that’s terrific. What an important contribution. And imagine my surprise when I saw that you two did “A Hard Day’s Night.”
